gate_40 did not change retention. The experiment data is trustworthy (sample ratio check passed), and neither the primary metric (retention_7) nor the secondary metric (retention_1) showed a statistically significant effect. The treatment arm had a negative impact on 7-day retention (-0.41 percentage points, p=0.116), while 1-day retention was unchanged (p=0.25). Since neither result is significant at the pre-registered alpha of 0.05, we should not roll out gate_40.

memo.answer: gate_40 did not change retention; neither the primary metric (retention_7) nor the secondary metric (retention_1) showed a statistically significant effect at the pre-registered alpha of 0.05, with p-values of 0.116 and 0.25 respectively.
